title: Verdict
description: One classification result. The ml-service emits it on the Redis verdicts channel; the backend and UI consume it. Contract shape from spec 0001 Feature design; score semantics settled there.

schema_version.description: Contract version. A breaking change bumps it.

flow_id.description: Matches the flow record this verdict is for.

model_id.description: The active model that produced this verdict (a registry manifest model_id).

score_kind.description: calibrated = predict_proba (the tree). uncalibrated = sigmoid(decision_function) (the SVMs). The UI labels an uncalibrated score so a distance is not read as a probability.

latency_ms.description: Inference latency for this flow, in milliseconds.

ts.description: When the verdict was produced, ISO 8601.

ground_truth.description: Echoed from the flow record for the metrics slice. Null for live.
